2.evidence_source: Tylka and Wood-Barcalow (2015b) developed a revision of the scale, the 10-item. Two studies have examined the factor structure of the BAS-2 outside the United States. In order to facilitate wider use of the BAS-2 in Chinese-speaking populations, we report on the translation and validation of a Standard Chinese version of the scale.
